description: This file defines error codes and message handling macros for the FreeType project, specifically for error handling and string generation related to error codes.

methods.name: FT_ERRORDEF
methods.description: Macro to define an error code with its value and message.

methods.name: FT_ERRORDEF_
methods.description: Macro to define an error code with a specific value and message, used internally.

methods.name: FT_NOERRORDEF_
methods.description: Macro to define the 'no error' code, which must be zero.
